notes: Typed Policy-Scoped Commit advisory-witness interface (psc.py v1.0.0, stdlib-only). PolicyScope (tenant, principal, purpose, consent_epoch, policy_version) fails closed on missing/unknown/malformed fields; PscRequest binds a commit-time claimed scope AND a dispatch-time scope (any divergence => REJECT SCOPE_CONFUSION, method-card threat table H). evaluate_psc(request, *, dependency_oracle, epoch_source) is a pure, total, deterministic function: wiring errors raise with stable codes; every case-level problem returns a typed PscDecision instead of raising. Outcomes COMMIT | REJECT | INDETERMINATE with stable reason codes; INDETERMINATE (DEPENDENCY_UNRESOLVED, DEPENDENCY_ORACLE_ERROR, EPOCH_SOURCE_ERROR, EPOCH_SOURCE_MALFORMED, EPOCH_SOURCE_UNKNOWN_PRINCIPAL) is a first-class outcome never counted as a safe rejection or completion (INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE_PROTOCOL rule 4); oracle/epoch failures become INDETERMINATE, never fabricated rejections; foreign exception text is sanitized to the exception class name only. Consent-epoch drift => REJECT EPOCH_CONSENT_STALE; claimed policy_version older than live => REJECT EPOCH_POLICY_DOWNGRADE; no orderable relation => REJECT EPOCH_POLICY_DIVERGENT; dependency changed since dispatch => REJECT DEPENDENCY_STALE; empty declared closure => REJECT DEPENDENCY_CLOSURE_EMPTY (arms cannot bypass the oracle). COMMIT is ADVISORY_WITNESS-enforced by construction: the decision type refuses any enforcement claim other than advisory, mirroring the method card's requirement that authorization be repeated inside the atomic transaction. DependencyOracle / GovernanceEpochSource are injected Protocols with frozen table-driven reference implementations (no I/O, no clock, no randomness); psc.py never imports candidate code — verified by a REAL oracle_contract.py AST independence scan (scan-clean.log, reason_code OK, 17 static imports, oracle_sha256 2c776060f262303a4ef722cbb59329b0304bf101fddaa98cb85849304c0bdde2). 26 task tests (8 positive incl. determinism/round-trip/first-class INDETERMINATE; 18 adversarial incl. missing tenant/purpose, unknown scope key, stale consent epoch, policy downgrade + divergent relation, cross-purpose/tenant/principal scope confusion, stale dependency version+digest, oracle/epoch crash sanitization, forged enforcement, empty closure injection) + full shared suite 69 passed; mypy clean under services/api env; ruff@0.7.1 check + format clean. source_sha_after = source_sha_before = base HEAD 9b6be889 (single-commit policy: report is written inside the same commit, so the recorded SHA cannot be the commit itself); STATE marking and sha refresh deferred to orchestrator. Downstream dependents (nine *-candidate venue tasks) should import from evaluation/venue2027/_shared/psc.py: PolicyScope, PscRequest, PscDecision, DependencyRef, evaluate_psc, plus the two reference injections.
